verdict.rationale: Kong's plugin architecture (rate limiting, transformations, logging) and Insomnia's pre-request scripts effectively act as configurable rules that trigger automatically on request/response events, giving some rule-based automation. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated event-driven rules/automation engine (e.g., custom triggers, conditional workflows, webhooks-on-event) beyond these built-in plugin hooks. missing for 10: a general-purpose rule/automation engine for arbitrary event triggers, documented examples of custom conditional actions, independent corroboration of automation depth.
